description: Build one final dispatch-level composite from validated orthogonal donors: keep fd3d941's n64 and 64-wide low-batch frontier available; import 32e1f1's n128, batch64/n256, batch16/n512, persistent-36-worker batch8/n2048, and batch1/n4096 paths; add 605768's fused batch60/n1024 chain and 417fe4's default-math direct-large POTRF delta. Resolve cache and pool ownership per shape, preserve caller-stream semantics, and measure both existing low-batch routes.

Integrated fd3d941 small n64 kernel with 32e1f1 n128, batch64/n256, batch16/n512, 36-worker persistent batch8/n2048, recursive batch1/n4096, 605768 fused batch60/n1024 chain, and 417fe4 default-math direct-large path. Selected the recursive grouped low-batch n1024/n2048 route. Full official/fresh validation and all 15 cells passed at 725.912 us; low-batch cells were 679.314/1280.258 us, batch60/n1024 878.498 us, batch8/n2048 1714.422 us, and large cells 4724.885/13006.544/47407.063 us.

Selected fd3d941's 64-wide TF32 frontier for batch4/n1024 and batch2/n2048 while preserving every other composite route. Full official/fresh validation and all 15 cells passed at 726.824 us versus 725.912 us for the recursive route. The changed cells measured 689.023/1349.676 us versus 679.314/1280.258 us; unchanged-shape noise included batch60/n1024 898.003 us and batch8/n2048 1700.676 us.

Restored the recursive grouped low-batch route after the direct A/B and ran a clean full-grid replicate. Full official/fresh validation and all 15 cells passed at a brief-best 724.672 us versus 725.912 us on the first recursive run and 726.824 us with the 64-wide frontier. Changed low-batch cells measured 714.683/1279.101 us; batch60/n1024 was 875.989 us, batch8/n2048 1703.020 us, and large cells 4714.392/12998.008/47298.022 us.

Final dispatch composite measured three fully validated passes. Brief-best commit d148f7d993df15ec7998704f86223907255b8a4f reached 724.672 us with the recursive low-batch routes, improving its first 725.912 us pass; the alternate fd3d941 64-wide low-batch route measured 726.824 us with changed cells 689.023/1349.676 versus recursive runs at 679.314-714.683/1279.101-1280.258. The composite retained fd3d941 n64, 32e1f1 n128/b64-n256/b16-n512/36-worker b8-n2048/b1-n4096, 605768 fused b60-n1024, and 417fe4 default-math large paths. Final clean cells included b60-n1024 875.989, b8-n2048 1703.020, and n8192/16384/32768 4714.392/12998.008/47298.022 us. It did not improve the run-wide fd3d941 leader at 715.900 us. No hosted profile was requested because manager approval was absent and local profiling is waived. The manager can retain fd3d941 as global best; a future run could isolate the medium-shape dispatch noise or submit the composite only if cross-run evidence is desired.
